messages:
maya: quick check — dense autoscale rows are saving space but folks miss controls. observed drop in burst toggles.

harry: agree. idea: tiny pill "Burst · Latency" at row end that expands into inline panel on click/enter.

lena: make it tabbable and announceable for screen readers. aria-expanded on pill, role=button.

choi: slider must have numeric input + +/- steppers. plus label 'Latency SLO (p95)'. tooltip: 'Target p95 model response latency.'

meera: when min > pool capacity show inline warning and CTA 'Suggest pools with capacity' that opens filtered modal sorted by estimated headroom.

infra-bot: headroom calc is heavy; cache per-modal-session and fall back to stale values if API slow.

designbot: uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mocks/2156781234/compact-pill-expand.png (includes keyboard flow and aria annotations).

maya: handoff checklist: focusable pill, inline panel, numeric steppers + slider aria, copy updates, inline warning + suggest modal, analytics (panel_open, burst_toggled, slo_changed, suggest_pool_click). I'll file INF-2244 and attach mocks.

harry: QA notes: keyboard steps: arrow +/-1, page +/-10, home/end to min/max. ensure numeric field sync.

lena: I'll draft localization-ready strings by EOD.

choi: also log headroom-timeout events and show fallback list.

maya: thanks all — creating ticket and moving to eng. :thumbsup:
